_about: 767-300 and 767-300ER (passenger), from Boeing D6-58328 Rev K 2.2.2 (page index 28): side, plan and front views on one sheet. Pixels of layers.py rasters at scale 20, line centres. The sheet prints no fuselage length: the scale is the plan's 54.94 m overall length, which is to the fin tip's trailing corner (the plan's dimension arrows, 301.66 pt apart; the 47.57 m span gives the same scale within 0.06%), so 'length' is the nose-to-tail-cone distance at that scale. The tailplane's tips reach 0.5 m behind the tail cone. A plain wingtip: the document has no winglet sheet. Its fills sit on a white panel (layers.py skips white fills).

windows.note: Boeing's drawing has no cabin windows: placed at the 767's 20 in (0.508 m) frame pitch, from behind door 1 to ahead of the aft door, none where door 2 is and one in the middle of each overwing exit; size and height from photos (0.27 by 0.40 m, their tops 0.55 m below the doors' tops).

sources.title: Boeing, 767 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (D6-58328 Rev K, December 2024), 2.2.2 General Dimensions: Model 767-300, -300ER; 2.7.1 Door Clearances
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/b763-passenger/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The 767-300 and -300ER passenger aircraft as Boeing draws them: plain wingtips (the document has no winglet sheet; most US 767-300ERs now fly with blended winglets, which this shape doesn't have), and door 2 (an option on the -300 and -300ER). Checks over 1.5%: the side view draws the fuselage 5.54 m tall between its own dimension arrows, labelled 5.41 m (+2.4%, as on the 767-300F's sheet); the shape keeps the drawing's. The plan draws the wing tip's leading-edge corner 34.15 m from the nose and its straight tip 1.71 m long, where it prints 32.87 m and 2.29 m; the 767-200 and 767-300F sheets draw the same tip, 3.1 m apart (the -300's forward plug) where their printed figures are 2.47 m apart, so the shape keeps the drawing's (a 2.08 m tip chord with its rounded corner). Also kept from the drawing: the engine's inlet 18.92 m from the nose (the side view; the plan draws it at 18.17 m, printed 18.72 m RR/PW, 18.54 m GE), and door 2's middle at 16.6 m (drawn there here and on the door sheet 2.7.1, whose figure is 15.96 m).
